articles.title: SUV Crosses Divider, Crashes Head-On Into Motorcycle Near Hebbalu Toll Gate; Two Seriously Injured
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two motorcyclists were seriously injured after a Mahindra SUV allegedly lost control, crossed the road divider, and collided head-on with their bike near the Hebbalu Toll Gate on a National Highway in Karnataka. The victims have been hospitalised as negligent driving is suspected.

body.html:
Two motorcyclists sustained serious injuries after a Mahindra SUV allegedly crossed the road divider and collided head-on with their bike near Hebbalu Toll Gate on the National Highway.

According to preliminary reports, the motorcycle was travelling from Chitradurga towards Davanagere when the SUV, coming from the opposite direction, allegedly lost control, crossed the divider, and rammed into the bike. The injured were rushed to a hospital, and negligent driving is suspected to have caused the crash. Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Drunken Brawl Between Tourist Groups at Maharashtra's Toranmal Hill Station Sparks Panic
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Maharashtra)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A violent clash erupted between two allegedly intoxicated tourist groups at Sitakhai Point in Maharashtra's Toranmal hill station, triggering panic. Women were reportedly jostled in the brawl. The incident sparked local outrage, with residents demanding stricter safety measures for visitors.

body.html:
A violent clash allegedly broke out between two groups of tourists at the popular hill station of Toranmal in Maharashtra's Nandurbar district, triggering panic among visitors.

The incident occurred at Sitakhai Point, where an argument reportedly erupted between the two groups while they were allegedly under the influence of alcohol. The verbal altercation soon escalated into a physical fight, creating a tense atmosphere at the tourist destination.

According to reports, women were also allegedly pushed and jostled during the scuffle. One group was reportedly from Chikhali Kanali village in Shahada tehsil, while the other was from Gogapur.

The incident has drawn criticism from local residents, who condemned the alleged nuisance caused by intoxicated tourists at the scenic spot. They also expressed concern over the safety of women visitors and urged authorities to enforce stricter measures to prevent such incidents in the future.

Further action in the case is awaited.

articles.title: Fake Priest Allegedly Extorts ₹4,000 From Devotee at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Police Intervene
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Varanasi)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man posing as a priest at Varanasi's Kashi Vishwanath Temple allegedly extorted ₹4,000 from a Mysuru devotee by promising special darshan. After swift police intervention, the accused refunded the money. A video of the incident went viral, prompting authorities to urge caution against scams.

body.html:
A man posing as a priest allegedly extorted ₹4,000 from a devotee by promising to facilitate darshan at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi.

According to reports, the devotee from Mysuru, Karnataka, complained after the self-styled priest allegedly demanded money for darshan. Police promptly intervened, and a video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

In the video, a police officer is heard telling the accused, "The whole world gets free darshan, and you are charging outsiders ₹4,000." Following the intervention, the accused allegedly refunded the entire amount to the devotee in the presence of the police.

The officer also assured the devotee that the police would help facilitate her darshan.

Officials noted that similar frauds have surfaced in the past. Last year, several people posing as priests at the Kashi Vishwanath Temple were arrested for allegedly extorting money from devotees under the pretext of arranging darshan and temple rituals.

Authorities have urged devotees to remain cautious and avoid paying unauthorised individuals for temple services. Similar scams have also been reported in other major pilgrimage centres, including Ujjain.

articles.title: Minor Driving Rented Car Allegedly Kills Man, Critically Injures Brother in Hyderabad
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Telangana)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was killed and his brother critically injured in Hyderabad after a rented car driven by a 17-year-old minor lost control and rammed their scooter. Police have detained the minor and two others. The tragedy has renewed concerns over underage driving and the misuse of rental vehicles.

body.html:
A man was killed and his brother critically injured after a rented car allegedly driven by a 17-year-old minor went out of control and crashed into them in Karmika Nagar under the Madhura Nagar Police Station limits in Hyderabad.

The deceased has been identified as Rajkumar, while his brother Prabhakar is undergoing treatment in critical condition. The two brothers were reportedly on their way to church when the accident occurred.

According to police, the white Maruti Baleno (TS09 FK 4804) had been rented earlier in the day by a 19-year-old youth, identified as Fawad, who, along with two other Intermediate students, had planned a trip.

Police said the group first drove to Karmika Nagar, where they washed the vehicle. After Fawad reportedly left on a motorcycle, inadvertently leaving the car keys inside, the 17-year-old allegedly attempted to drive the vehicle despite not being proficient behind the wheel.

The car allegedly went out of control, crashing into seven parked motorcycles before crossing onto the opposite side of the road and hitting the scooter carrying the two brothers. Police said the vehicle also ran over the victims after the collision.

Both men sustained serious injuries and were rushed to hospital. Rajkumar later succumbed to his injuries, while Prabhakar remains under treatment.

Following the incident, police took all three occupants of the car into custody and registered a case. Investigators are examining the circumstances under which the rented vehicle came into the possession of the minor, as well as the role of the adults accompanying him.

Police also said the Baleno is registered in the name of Shaik Azmatullah and has pending traffic challans worth ₹3,240 dating back to September 2025.

The incident has once again raised concerns over minors driving without valid licences and the responsibility of those who permit or facilitate such acts, particularly in cases involving rented vehicles.

articles.title: Young Medical Student Dies After Car Allegedly Hits Her Three Times; Family Donates Organs
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Andhra Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased, Dr Kanike Priyanka
articles.excerpt: Dr. Kanike Priyanka, a 28-year-old PG medical student, died days after a car driven by two allegedly intoxicated youths rammed her two-wheeler multiple times in Rajahmundry. Police have detained the suspects. Amid widespread outrage, her grieving family has chosen to donate her organs.

body.html:
A 28-year-old postgraduate medical student died after allegedly being hit multiple times by a car following a confrontation involving two youths outside a mall in Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh.

The deceased, Dr Kanike Priyanka, was pursuing her postgraduate medical education at GSL Medical College. She succumbed to her injuries at KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad on Sunday, August 9, after battling for her life for nearly a week.

The incident took place on August 3 near Prasad Aditya Mall on AV Appa Rao Road, under the limits of Prakash Nagar Police Station.

According to police, two youths had allegedly consumed alcohol before arriving at the shopping complex and got into an argument with security personnel. After leaving the mall, the duo allegedly drove away in an agitated state.

Priyanka was travelling as a pillion rider on a two-wheeler with a friend when their vehicle was allegedly struck by the car. Police said the accused allegedly hit the two-wheeler three times, causing Priyanka to fall and suffer severe head injuries. The car reportedly passed over her head.

Priyanka was initially rushed to a hospital in Rajahmundry and was later shifted to KIMS Hospital in Secunderabad for advanced neurological treatment as her condition remained critical.

Despite doctors' efforts, she was declared brain-dead and later died on Sunday afternoon.

East Godavari SP D. Narasimha Kishore said police had registered an attempt-to-murder case against the accused and were taking further legal action. Police have detained two persons, including Suravarapu Yaswanth, who was allegedly driving the car.

The tragedy has triggered anger among medical students and members of the medical fraternity, who have demanded strict action against those responsible and a thorough investigation into the circumstances of the incident.

Amid their grief, Priyanka's family agreed to donate her organs, potentially giving a new lease of life to other patients.

Priyanka's death has also renewed concerns over alleged drunk and reckless driving and its potentially devastating consequences for innocent road users.

articles.title: Love Affair Turns Deadly in UP: Man Accused of Killing Girlfriend's Husband Shot in Leg During Police Encounter
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The accused Hashim and victim Talib.
articles.excerpt: A man accused of murdering his girlfriend's husband in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar was arrested after he was allegedly shot in the leg during a police encounter on Sunday morning.

body.html:
A man accused of murdering his girlfriend's husband in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar was arrested after he was allegedly shot in the leg during a police encounter on Sunday morning.

The accused, identified as Hashim, was arrested in the Budhana area after police reportedly received information about his presence on Mandwara Road. Police said Hashim opened fire when officers attempted to surround him, following which police fired in retaliation and a bullet hit his leg.

A pistol and cartridges were allegedly recovered from his possession. He was taken into custody and admitted to a hospital for treatment.

According to police, the incident began around 7 am on Saturday, when Talib, a resident of Meerut who worked in Surat, arrived at his in-laws' house in Budhana to take his wife with him.

Police suspect Talib's wife had informed Hashim, with whom she allegedly had a relationship, about her husband's arrival. Hashim allegedly reached the spot and attacked Talib with an axe. CCTV footage reportedly captured the attack.

Talib suffered serious injuries and was taken to a hospital with the help of his wife and bystanders. As his condition deteriorated, he was referred to Meerut, where he died during treatment.

Police subsequently launched a search for Hashim. Officials said he was later traced to Mandwara Road, where the alleged encounter took place.

CO Budhana Gajendra Pal Singh reached the spot after receiving information about the encounter and inspected the area. The operation was carried out by a police team led by SHO Subhash Atri and Town Police Post Officer Lalit Kasana. Police collected evidence from the scene.

Investigators said a preliminary probe points to an alleged love affair as the motive behind the murder. Police are questioning Hashim to establish the exact circumstances, identify the weapon used and determine whether anyone else was involved.

CCTV footage of the alleged attack has also circulated on social media and is being examined as part of the investigation.

Police have registered a murder case and other relevant charges against Hashim. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: UP Woman Allegedly Murdered by Husband in Fake Road Accident for ₹44 Lakh Insurance
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Amar Singh, Rita
articles.excerpt: A 32-year-old woman, Rita, was allegedly murdered by her husband, Amar Singh, and three accomplices in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur in a plot to claim ₹44 lakh in life insurance.

body.html:
A 32-year-old woman, Rita, was allegedly murdered by her husband, Amar Singh, and three accomplices in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur in a plot to claim ₹44 lakh in life insurance.

Police said the accused first rammed Rita with a car, then pulled her from a roadside ditch and deliberately ran over her again to make the murder appear as a road accident. Amar Singh later even filed a missing person complaint to mislead investigators.

Initially treated as an accident, the case was cracked through technical evidence, surveillance and interrogation. Police arrested Amar Singh and his three accomplices, alleging the murder was planned to claim the insurance money and repay debts.

articles.title: Traffic Constable Suspended After Drunken Argument With Motorist Caught on Camera in UP's Banda
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Arun Singh (who identified himself as a traffic police constable)
articles.excerpt: A traffic police constable has been suspended after a video showing him allegedly arguing with a motorist while under the influence of alcohol surfaced on social media in Uttar Pradesh's Banda district.

body.html:
A traffic police constable has been suspended after a video showing him allegedly arguing with a motorist while under the influence of alcohol surfaced on social media in Uttar Pradesh's Banda district.

The incident took place at around 4 pm on Saturday near the TB Hospital under the City Kotwali police station limits. The viral video shows a heated argument between the constable and a young man on the roadside.

According to the complaint filed by Shubham Gupta, a resident of Awas Vikas Colony, he was driving to his second house when a white car parked on the road allegedly blocked his way. He claimed that after requesting the driver to move the vehicle, Arun Singh, who identified himself as a traffic police constable, became aggressive.

Shubham alleged that when he attempted to reverse his car, the constable struck the bonnet of his vehicle, demanded that he move quickly, abused him, and attempted to assault him. He also alleged that the constable was intoxicated and subsequently informed the Civil Lines Police Station.

Following the circulation of the video on social media, police took cognisance of the incident and launched an inquiry. While the video captures the heated exchange, it does not independently verify the allegations of assault or other claims.

CO Traffic Saurabh Singh said that after examining the video, the constable was found to be under the influence of alcohol and involved in the roadside argument. He has been placed under suspension, and departmental proceedings have been initiated against him.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Tragic Final Moments as Man on Phone Fatally Struck by Train in Jalandhar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking CCTV video showing the final moments of a man being fatally hit by a speeding train in Punjab's Jalandhar has gone viral on social media, once again highlighting the dangers of using mobile phones near railway tracks.

body.html:
A shocking CCTV video showing the final moments of a man being fatally hit by a speeding train in Punjab's Jalandhar has gone viral on social media, once again highlighting the dangers of using mobile phones near railway tracks.

The incident occurred on August 1 near DAV Heart Railway Station, where the victim was allegedly distracted by a phone call and failed to notice an approaching train.

According to reports, the CCTV footage shows the man walking along a dirt path beside the railway tracks while talking on his mobile phone. As he moved towards the tracks, he appeared unaware of the oncoming train despite repeated warnings from bystanders. Moments later, the speeding train struck him, killing him on the spot.

The deceased has been identified as Sukhwinder Kumar, also known as Tinku, a resident of Vijaypur, Jammu. He had been living in Jalandhar for the past four years and worked at a vegetable shop.

His employer, Saurabh, said Sukhwinder left work at around 5:30 pm and was walking home when he received a phone call.

Preliminary findings suggest he remained engrossed in the conversation while approaching the railway tracks, preventing him from noticing the approaching train or responding to warnings from people nearby.

Government Railway Police (GRP) Head Constable Pritpal Singh said police received information about the accident shortly after it occurred. Officers reached the spot, took custody of the body and sent it for a post-mortem examination. Further legal action will be taken after recording statements from the victim's family.

The incident has sparked widespread discussion online, with many urging people to remain alert around railway tracks and avoid using mobile phones while crossing or walking near railway lines.
